content_en: I want to take a short trip next month. I have been busy with work, so I need some time to relax. First, I will check my schedule and choose a good date. Then, I will look for a hotel and book my train tickets. I also want to make a list of places to visit. I will ask my friend to come with me because traveling together is more fun. We have not decided where to go yet, but I am already excited about the trip.
content_cn: 我想下个月进行一次短途旅行。最近我一直忙于工作，所以我需要一些时间放松一下。首先，我会查看自己的日程，选一个合适的日期。然后，我会寻找酒店并预订火车票。我还想列出一份想去的地方清单。我会邀请朋友和我一起去，因为结伴旅行更有趣。我们还没有决定去哪里，但我已经开始期待这次旅行了。

content_en: My friend and I are choosing a place for our next vacation. He wants to visit a big city because he enjoys shopping and museums. I prefer the beach because I love swimming and quiet mornings. We looked at some pictures online and read a few travel reviews. A small coastal town looks beautiful and not too expensive. It also has good seafood restaurants. We both like the idea, so we may go there for four days in June.
content_cn: 我和朋友正在为下一次假期选择一个地方。他想去大城市，因为他喜欢购物和参观博物馆。我更喜欢海边，因为我喜欢游泳和安静的早晨。我们在网上看了一些照片，也读了几篇旅行评价。一座小海滨城镇看起来很漂亮，而且消费不太贵。那里还有不错的海鲜餐厅。我们都喜欢这个想法，所以可能会在六月去那里玩四天。

sentences.explanation: coastal 意为沿海的；look 后面可以接形容词描述外观或状态。

content_en: I found a nice hotel near the beach. It is close to several restaurants and a bus stop. I checked the price on the hotel website and compared it with two other places. The room has a large bed, free Wi-Fi, and a small balcony. I want to stay for three nights, so I called the hotel to ask about the total cost. The price is reasonable, and breakfast is included. I booked a room online and received a confirmation email.
content_cn: 我找到了一家海滩附近的不错酒店。它离几家餐厅和一个公交车站都很近。我在酒店网站上查看了价格，并与另外两家酒店进行了比较。房间有一张大床、免费无线网络和一个小阳台。我想住三个晚上，所以打电话给酒店询问总费用。价格很合理，而且包含早餐。我在网上订了一间房，并收到了确认邮件。

content_en: My trip is only two days away, so I need to pack my suitcase tonight. I will take three shirts, two pairs of pants, and a warm jacket. I also need my toothbrush, phone charger, and travel documents. The weather may be rainy, so I will bring an umbrella. I do not want to carry too many things because my suitcase is quite small. Before I leave, I will check my list again to make sure I have everything.
content_cn: 距离我的旅行只剩两天了，所以我今晚需要收拾行李箱。我会带三件衬衫、两条裤子和一件保暖外套。我还需要带上牙刷、手机充电器和旅行证件。天气可能会下雨，所以我要带一把雨伞。我不想带太多东西，因为我的行李箱比较小。出发前，我会再检查一遍清单，确保东西都带齐了。

content_en: I arrived at the airport two hours before my flight. The airport was busy, but the signs were easy to understand. First, I found the check-in counter and showed my passport. The staff member checked my ticket and gave me a boarding pass. Then I left my suitcase at the baggage counter. After that, I went through security and looked for my gate. I still had some time, so I bought a bottle of water and waited near the gate.
content_cn: 我在航班起飞前两个小时到达了机场。机场很繁忙，但指示牌很容易看懂。首先，我找到了值机柜台并出示了护照。工作人员检查了我的机票，并给了我一张登机牌。然后，我在行李托运柜台托运了行李箱。之后，我通过了安检，并寻找自己的登机口。我还有一些时间，所以买了一瓶水，在登机口附近等待。

sentences.sentence_cn: 机场很繁忙，但指示牌很容易看懂。

sentences.explanation: leave 在这里表示交存、留下；baggage counter 指行李托运柜台。

content_en: I found my seat near the window and put my bag under the seat in front of me. The plane was almost full, so many people were looking for their seats. content_en: When I travel, I always want to try local food. Today, my friend took me to a small restaurant near the old town. content_en: I came home last night after a five-day trip. I was tired, but I felt happy to be back. First, I unpacked my suitcase and put my clothes in the washing machine. content_en: I work for a small software company. My job is to help customers use our products. Every day, I answer emails, make phone calls, and solve simple problems. Sometimes I work with the design team to improve our website. The work can be busy, but I enjoy helping people. My manager is kind, and my coworkers are helpful. In the future, I hope to learn more skills and take on bigger projects. I like my job because every day is a little different.

content_en: Yesterday, I had trouble using a new computer program at work. I tried to finish the report, but I could not find the right tool. I asked my coworker, Anna, for help. She came to my desk and showed me what to do. Then she explained the steps slowly and answered my questions. After that, I could finish the report by myself. I thanked her for taking the time to help me. Asking for help made my work much easier.
content_cn: 昨天，我在工作中使用一个新电脑程序时遇到了困难。我试着完成报告，但找不到合适的工具。于是我向同事安娜求助。她来到我的办公桌旁，告诉我应该怎么做。接着，她慢慢解释了操作步骤，并回答了我的问题。之后，我就能独立完成报告了。我感谢她抽出时间帮助我。寻求帮助让我的工作轻松了许多。
